name: @bogahost/native-finans
description: Bogahost Finans — Capacitor WebView kabuğu (canlı https://finans.bogahost.com/admin yükler).

scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO
